title: Download controls
summary: The buttons: is Plexo answering, start it, stop only the one this console started, stop every download - plus the route and the records behind them.

surfaces.usb: DEGRADED(the button that starts Plexo refuses by name on a stick that carries no payload and names the fetcher; the engine buttons still work, because the engine is this kit's own code. Nothing is ever downloaded by a click)
surfaces.web: N/A(same steward decision as the other actuator cards: a browser tab cannot start a process or own a download on this machine)

notes: The actuator half of the download pair: `lygo.plexoinfo` reads the facts and this module is where Plexo is started, checked and stopped and where running downloads are cancelled. It owns exactly one thing - save/plexo, this harness's own small state (which pid this console started, and when) - written through atomicio behind the p0 gate. It renders nothing itself: every call goes through the `plexo` limb's own harness, declared here as owned (the limb lives in limbs.py and is not re-registered, so no tool changes behaviour and none is listed twice). WHAT IT WILL NOT DO: it will not stop a Plexo it did not start (a window the operator opened belongs to the operator, and `stop` refuses that case BY NAME); it will not claim Plexo is up because a process was spawned (its bridge answering on 19288-19290 is the proof, and a first launch that has not answered yet says exactly that); it will not hand a link to Plexo without an explicit consent (that starts a download on someone's metered connection); it will not fetch the 246 MB installer - the button refuses and names scripts/fetch_plexo.ps1; and it will never claim a speed-up it did not measure.
